checks.message: Enable vault lock for compliance workloads requiring WORM storage
checks.context: Glacier vaults without vault lock can have archives deleted at any time. For compliance use cases (HIPAA, SEC 17a-4, FINRA), initiate a vault lock policy to make archives immutable.

checks.message: Verify the vault policy doesn't grant public access
checks.context: A vault access policy with Principal: * makes your archived data accessible to any AWS principal. Glacier archives often contain sensitive long-term data — scope access to specific IAM roles.

checks.message: Vault must be empty before deletion — all archives must be deleted first
checks.context: You can't delete a vault that contains archives. Deleting archives from Glacier is a multi-step async process (initiate job, wait up to 24h, then delete). Plan this operation well in advance.

checks.message: Lifecycle rules that expire objects are permanent — verify the scope before applying
checks.context: A lifecycle rule with Expiration on a prefix that's too broad will silently delete objects that match. Test with a narrow prefix first and verify the rule targets exactly what you intend.
